@janismullan I didn’t say it is #MeToo. It’s about a PM’s hypocrisy & moral character - who first lied, & now refuses to clarify, neither denying or confirming, but, in essence calling the woman a liar - she misjudged. He refuses to be responsible & to accept it’s about him, not society.
